verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud development and agent platform like Replit, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted, on-prem or downloadable server edition of the core product. The docs describe only Replit-hosted services, publishing and deployments, and the Desktop App is a client, not a self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
